    Plot Mean Squared Error (MSE) vs. Rank for NMF

    plotMSEvsRank.Rd

    Computes and plots the Mean Squared Error (MSE) of Non-negative Matrix Factorization (NMF) for different ranks to help evaluate the optimal rank for decomposition.

    plotMSEvsRank(dataset, ranks, mask = NULL, seed = NULL)

    Arguments

    dataset

    A numeric matrix (dense or sparse) representing the data to be factorized.

    ranks

    A numeric vector specifying the different rank values to test.

    mask

    A matrix of the same dimensions as dataset specifying missing values to be ignored (optional, default: NULL).

    seed

    A numeric value specifying the random seed for reproducibility (optional, default: NULL).

    Value

    A plot of MSE vs. rank.

    Details

    This function applies NMF to the dataset for each rank in ranks, calculates the reconstruction MSE, and plots the results.

    Examples

    library(RcppML)
#> RcppML v0.5.5 using 'options(RcppML.threads = 0)' (all available threads), 'options(RcppML.verbose = FALSE)'
dataset <- matrix(runif(100), 10, 10)  # Generate a random dataset
ranks <- seq(2, 10, by = 2)  # Define ranks to test
plotMSEvsRank(dataset, ranks)
